description: Capability for the opening screen (label `splash`), the bundled local page that plays the logo reveal while the dashboard server boots, and on a Mac that has not seen it yet the one-time intro before it. It needs exactly four things: to ask the shell to start its clip (`splash_play`: played from the shell's eval it counts as a user gesture, which Low Power Mode requires), to say its clip is done (`splash_done`), and for the intro to say it waits for a click (`intro_hold`) and that it was played or skipped (`intro_seen`). No core window controls (the shell shows, fades and closes it from Rust), no events, no shell:*, and no remote URL — it is a local page only.
